rules: Never accept arbitrary unknown keys from clients.
Bound serialized JSON size, depth and supported fields; never credentials or business-record lists.
Anonymous registration drafts remain non-sensitive staged client state until registration; no passwords stored.
Global builder configuration is Admin-write, public-read only for approved display keys.
State aliases are mapped in services/state.js; resource aliases must dispatch canonical endpoints.

dynamicKeys.allowlistedNames: Literal KEY constants in active admin controllers; no arbitrary names
